feed.title: Full Stack Developer (React.js, Next.js, Node.js & AWS) - For our websites and applications
feed.description:
Note: contact via email, phone or Linkedin will mean disqualification. Apply on Upwork only.

We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer to enhance our web application using React.js, Next.js, and Node.js. Our websites for Grow Skills Store, FIT4Privacy and Punit Bhatia are built using learnpress, zoho, woo commerce and wordpress. The role involves integrating AWS services to improve performance and scalability. The ideal candidate will have experience in cloud computing and a strong understanding of web development best practices. Responsibilities include developing new features, optimizing existing code, and collaborating with our team to deliver high-quality solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to work on an ongoing web application.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with React.js and Next.js
Backend development using Node.js and Express.js
REST API development and third-party API integrations
Database experience with MongoDB or PostgreSQL
AWS deployment and management (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront)
Authentication and role-based access control
Git/GitHub and CI/CD workflows
Performance optimization and bug fixing
Responsibilities:
Develop new frontend and backend features
Build secure and scalable APIs
Deploy and maintain applications on AWS
Troubleshoot production issues
Write clean and reusable code
Coordinate regularly with our project manager and development team
Requirements:
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience
Good understanding of scalable application architecture
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
Clear communication and regular progress updates
Availability for ongoing work
Please share relevant React/Next.js projects, your AWS experience, availability, and hourly rate when applying.

Note: contact via email, phone or Linkedin will mean disqualification. Apply on Upwork only.
